# Kenney CC0 candidate-pack provenance

This directory contains a deliberately small selection copied without mesh edits from two
official Kenney downloads. It is used only by `FreeAssetPackCandidate.unity` while the product
owner evaluates whether this simplified 3D direction is suitable.

## Furniture Kit 2.0

- Official page: https://kenney.nl/assets/furniture-kit
- Download URL: https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/furniture-kit/440e0608a4-1677580847/kenney_furniture-kit.zip
- Downloaded: 2026-08-31 (Asia/Shanghai)
- SHA-256: `e67652d0932cee41683f74711c03d3e192a2af9979ef8e6b237711f5482d46b0`
- License copied verbatim to `FurnitureKit/LICENSE.txt`: Creative Commons Zero (CC0)
- Selected files: original FBX files from `Models/FBX format/`; filenames were preserved.

## Candidate-scene limitation

Neither imported furniture pack contains a purpose-built salon shampoo station. The candidate
scene therefore labels its sink-plus-armchair assembly as a **proxy**, not as a production-ready
wash station. The furniture and character meshes visible in the evidence frame are real imported
Kenney or KayKit models; only room layout, transforms, lighting, and simple Unity materials are
project work.
